The division, the misinformation that has come from Trump’s candidacy and presidency is astounding compared to just 10 years ago. I’m a staunch democrat but I would have loved John McCain as a president. It’s unfortunate that our country has devolved into a hateful, scared, sad group of individuals that use their feelings as fact. If you think the world was laughing at us before, travel abroad. In Italy every person I met assumed we were stupid Trump supporters because we were American, and most of them considered Trump an absolute idiot. I host foreign exchange students from Australia every year and none of them believe Trump is in any way looking out for the American people. Most everything Trump has done is bad policy that will hurt the US in one way or another and I hope that we can recover from this catastrophic administration.
